parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.

You must specify the instance ID. Otherwise, the call fails. You can view your instance ID on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.
><notice>
If the public instance does not have an ID, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).
></notice>

parameters.name: JobCode
parameters.description: The push task ID. The **Data** field returned after a successful call to [PushSpeech](~~217573~~) is the push task ID.

parameters.name: PageId
parameters.description: The current page number. Valid values: 1 to 10000.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: ProjectCode
parameters.description: The project ID, which is the unique identifier of the project. You can obtain the project ID from the [Project Management console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/things-service/projects).

parameters.name: PushMode
parameters.description:
The mode of the push task. If this parameter is not specified, all modes are queried.

- **SINGLE_DEVICE**: single-device push.
- **ALL**: full-device push.
- **GROUP_DEVICE**: group-device push.

parameters.name: StatusList
parameters.description:
The status list of corpus push tasks to query. If this parameter is not specified, all statuses are queried.

- **RUNNING**: running.
- **CANCEL**: canceled.
- **SUCCESS**: succeeded.
- **TIMEOUT**: timed out.
